name: Brand Visual Direction
purpose: Translate a locked brand strategy into 3-5 materially distinct creative territories and a single selected visual grammar (mood, color logic, typography logic, imagery language, compositional principles) before identity assets are systematized.
triggers: art direction / moodboard logic is needed before identity assets are built
real risk of landing on generic, category-default, or AI-slop visual output
non_triggers: producing the final brand book, logo, or asset library
decorative moodboarding with no strategic rationale
generating a single image with no comparative territories
quality_gates: every pair of surviving territories passes the divergence audit (disagrees on 4+ of 8 axes)
every element of APPROVED_VISUAL_DIRECTION.md traces to a named strategy attribute or score rationale
VISUAL_ANTI_PATTERNS.md is non-empty and includes flagged clichés
GENERATION_LANGUAGE.md entries are principle-level, not single scene descriptions
grammar addresses composition, type, color, imagery, and density/motion/UI
stop_conditions: all four required artifacts produced, divergence audit passed, direction traced to strategy -> COMPLETE
BRAND_STRATEGY.md missing/unlocked/insufficient -> BLOCKED, state what strategy elements are needed
fewer than 3 territories pass divergence audit after two rebuild attempts -> PARTIAL, surface the collision explicitly
never present cosmetically different territories as materially distinct, or an untraced grammar rule as final
